title: A key added after a block scalar whose last line is only spaces and ends the file
notes:
Exactly yaml-test-suite L24T/01. The value of `foo` is `x
 
`; the line break that ends the line of spaces is written before the new key, and the missing final line break stays missing. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend refused the edit as one that would not read back; the pure backend wrote the key before the line of spaces.
